text: Good evening, madam mayor, Mr. Vice mayor and the commission. A detail was created in order to assist in bringing down the calls for service and try to get the management companies to assist us in taking care of some of the calls that really weren't police related calls. So the numbers that I have for the first quarter of this year at the 201 building would be the percentage rate that it went down. It's at 2001 Southwest 67th Avenue is six per month. We were at 12.8 per month in calls in 2020. In 2101 or at 2101 building, we were at 12.6 in 2020. Right now we're at 11.6, but I will talk about that shortly. At 2201, we were at 13 calls per month. In 2101, the good news is, is that as of two weeks ago, they have 41 evictions to be done out of the 41, five have been done already and there's 36 pending and they're all coming up in a quick order within the next month or so. So there is 36 pending in the system. As far as the manager asked me to go ahead and report on the UCR, UCR is the Uniform Crime Reporting for last year for 2020. The violent offenses were down by 12.2% from 2019. Property offenses were down 7.5% from 2019. Other minor offenses, which were considered part two crimes instead of part one crimes, all in the simple assault category were up 78.6%. We attribute that to the cabin fever in 2020 because of COVID. Domestic violent offenses were down 6.3%, believe it or not. Arrests were up by 75% from our department. We recovered 50% more stolen vehicles than the previous year that were stolen outside the city of West Miami and recovered within the city of West Miami. And we had no stolen vehicles at all last year in 2020. The total crime rate in 2019 was 1,341.3, total between part one and part two crimes.
